decisions.reason: The source's OR-ing method, participating sources, and source-selection behavior are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source's conditional 5V supply and GPIO3 switching for the SK6812 LEDs are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.
The source's 1200 mA boost rating and complete list of 5V loads are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The battery voltage range and connection to AXP2101 are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the connector's other attributes are unchanged.
The power mapping does not change how charge status is conveyed, its GPIO, or the CHGLED connector circuitry; SK6812 supply behavior is owned by the separate LED power requirement.
The operating-mode power mapping does not change the interboard connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or matching-numbering requirement.
Identifying the supplies for I2C devices does not alter I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-ups, or series-resistor configuration.
The statement that the battery feeds AXP2101 and AXP2101 powers downstream loads does not change the candidate's VMID-to-VSYS topology or net-label requirements.
The source discusses USB-C on the main board for standalone power and does not change the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The electrical power mapping does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The battery-to-AXP2101 power path does not change the requirement to monitor battery temperature through the J_BAT NTC.
The stated 2.8–4.6V battery feed range and downstream power mapping do not modify the existing overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
